comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
Just a heads up, the ship skills on UWOtool are listed incorrectly. The correct skills set (listed correctly in an earlier comment) is actually:

Special smoke bomb (Special high explosives + Metal work)
Nanban Trade Preference (E. Asia Nanban Trade Ship Hold + Warehouse)
Demolition work (Control tower + Set of dismantling tools)
Pre-emptive attack (Traverse rope + Mast top)

This is important due to this ships status as an Astro mat ship.
